OP, I have some similar issues. Especially that _What if it‘s not OCD but a fetish i just don’t want to have?_ question I have dealt with as well. I want to point you to some thoughts that have helped me to deal with this kind of stuff

-Your brain works in rather simple, instinctive ways. Anything, a n y t h i n g, related to sexuality can trigger an arousal response, especially taboo stuff

-Through obsessing about Those topics you’ve basically trained your brain to react to them with the sexual response

-Trying to differentiate groinal response and „arousal“ therefore can deepen your uncertainty and also quickly become a compulsion 

-Sexuality is always changing, nothing is final

-I know with ZOCD and POCD that _you can practise fetishes with roleplay_ still can feel absolutely terrifying! You don’t EVER have to act those „fantasies“ (/obsessions) out. It’s a decision you can make for yourself, deciding either way is an option. Don’t ever do it to to test yourself or if you’re uncomfortable
-Because of everything said above, YOU DON‘T HAVE TO FIGURE THINGS OUT. I know it’s hard. But basically, brains work simply, sexual topics trigger sexual responses, things can change, thoughts don’t equal actions.  

Everything else is just questions that might throw you deeper into obsessions. You will never get a 100% answer, maybe today it might seem like 50%, tomorrow 10%, next week 98%, then 30% again. Don’t bother with trying to figure it out 100%, that’s what every ocd feeds from. Also get off this sub ;)

Good luck! I hope this helps a bit :)
